fieldValues.title: Which records start at the human tip, which rise to it, and which never need it?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: No option chosen. Raised as an open question in Research (4. The human tip: a managed layer when it is worth it), 2026-10-30, and turned into an exercise so options are explored before any decision.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. By type: decisions and the repository's purpose start at the tip; problems and remedies may rise; clusters, findings and tensions never need it.
- B. By domain: the owner names the domains where the tip is managed.
- C. By confidence: a record rises to the tip when its confidence crosses a line and it matters for ranking.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Which affirmed records changed what happened, and which were affirmed without effect.
fieldValues.next_action: Sample affirmed records by type and check whether anything read their affirmation.
